title: The quadrant law: the corner returns at the Catalan times
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-10, before the proof attempt. Doubled coordinates of FULL-REACH-PROOF-20261108-001A: contacts are the points (X, Y) with X + Y odd; an h (X odd) reads (X +- 1, Y +- 1) with equal signs, a v (X even) reads (X +- 1, Y -+ 1); reads leaving the region die; A[c, d] = 1 when c reads d, over GF(2). The box is [0, N]^2, N = 2n - 2; the quadrant is [0, oo)^2; the half-strips are [0, N] x [0, oo) and [0, oo) x [0, N]. The corner contact is c = (0, 1), and r(w) = sum_k A^k[c, c] w^k its return series. C(z) = sum_j z^(2^j - 1) is the Catalan series mod 2 and L(z) = z + z^2 + z^4 + ... + z^n the trace polynomial of GF(2n). Target A1: in the quadrant r(w) = C(w^4) over GF(2), equivalently the corner's first returns are odd exactly at the times 4 * 2^j. Target A2 (secondary, over the integers): the corner returns of length 4k number C_k^2; on the h contacts (2i + 1, 2j) this is the statement that the simple walks in the quarter plane that never step west along the x-axis have C_k^2 excursions of length 2k. Found before registration (computed, this thread): A1 below w^1200 (REACH-HALVES-20261110-001A); A2 for k <= 12 (exact integers); under the reflection in the line X - Y = -1 through the corner, a symmetry of the walk, the walks left over mod 2 are those whose every excursion off the line lies on the bottom-wall side and touches Y = 0 (their numbers 1, 2, 7, 34, 206, 1458, ... at k = 1, 2, 3, ... have the parity of C_k^2 to k = 12).
failure_conditions: A time at which the quadrant's corner return count is odd and not of the form 4(2^j - 1), or even at such a time (computed false below w^1200).
A k at which the corner returns of length 4k are not C_k^2 in number (computed false for k <= 12).
remaining_obligations: A1 by proof, or the lemma that would finish it, checked exactly below w^1200
A2 by proof or as a computed law with its stress test one size past
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), its walk over GF(2), and the same walk with one or both far walls removed. Returns are a contact-level reading, so they do not depend on how the rings are declared beyond which contacts each ring holds (A45).
